Maths at work

Hair and beauty

Jobs in this route, and the maths they use.

Ratio

Hairdresser

Route: Hair and beauty

Colour is mixed with developer in the ratio the maker gives. Wella's Koleston Perfect is mixed \(1 : 1\), but its Special Blonde shades are mixed \(1 : 2\). You use 40 g of a Special Blonde shade.

  1. Colour : developer = \(1 : 2\).
  2. Developer = \(40 \times 2 = 80\) g.

Sources

Every job and every figure that is not an example comes from a public page you can check.
